items.reason: Gap 0 describes two concurrent deliveries both seeing the id absent before either records it, so the handler runs twice.
Gap 2 says the key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that altering it on a validly signed body replays the event.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while HANDLERS registers refund.created, so the refund handler never runs.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 concerns workers within the one queue.
